content: Soogv kokwng lo ngo kvvbi nyikrw godv kaato namv nyidomooku tologv riapgu ako chikuk dubv kaato. Okv bikartapu minam aingbv vlvgo duunamv, nga kvvlo lokv mimbv dunvbv ngo tvvto, okv minto, “soka chaatoka, okv soogv kokwnglo ogugo rirung tvvdunvdw ngo nam kaatamre.”
